## Phase 2 Entry Checklist

Before Phase 2 starts, humans must approve:

- V2 decision record
- Memory top-level vs LifeModel-subnav decision
- ReviewItem state machine
- Workspace responsibility migration
- Chinese product vocabulary
- Diagnostics visibility policy
- ViewModel ownership strategy
- backend contract non-hallucination check
- E2E/desktop trial expectations
